own_solution.law: Parallel-plate capacitor at fixed potential difference: eps0 A = C0 d0; force between plates F = eps0 A V^2/(2 d^2) = C0 d0 V^2/(2 d^2).

T75D2.regime: no breakdown while the largest field reached (900 V / 2 mm = 450 kV/m at the start) stays below 1900 kV/m

T56FA.regime: no breakdown while the largest field (450 kV/m) is below 1900 kV/m

notes: eps0 A = 100 pF x 2 mm = 2e-13 F m. F = 2e-13 x 900^2/(2 x (5e-3)^2) = 3.24e-3 N. With 1350 V: 7.29e-3 N. Even with 1350 V the largest field (675 kV/m at 2 mm) is below 1900 kV/m, so the breakdown sentences are K. T0373 does not say when the extra battery is connected, but the final force depends only on final V and d, so the answer is the same either way. Breakdown sentences state the same 1900 kV/m in two wordings; the 450 V sentences agree.
